summary_en: This Phase 1b/2 trial tests pidnarulex (CX-5461) in adults with aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that has MYC gene changes. Pidnarulex is given by IV over 60 minutes on days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle, and cycles repeat without disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The trial is listed as Phase 1/Phase 2 and aims to assess safety, side effects, best dose and how well the treatment works.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1b/2 evalúa pidnarulex (CX-5461) en adultos con linfoma no Hodgkin de células B agresivo que presenta cambios en el gen MYC. El pidnarulex se administra por vía intravenosa durante 60 minutos los días 1 y 8 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y los ciclos se repiten sin progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El ensayo está registrado como fase 1/fase 2 y busca evaluar la seguridad, los efectos secundarios, la dosis óptima y qué tan bien funciona el tratamiento.
who_for: Aggressive B-cell lymphoma of double-expressor, high-grade with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangement, or Burkitt type.
At least two prior lines for DLBCL, or at least one prior line for Burkitt lymphoma, with no effective standard options left.
Performance status ECOG 2 or better; ECOG 3 allowed if related to the lymphoma.
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function, and heart function (NYHA class II or better).
not_for: Taking strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or strong CYP3A4 inducers.
Prior allergic reaction to compounds similar to CX-5461.
